record.label: production-branch reference; deployment unverified
record.scope: The four units in appliesTo declare EXPLOSION in this production reference. The strategy is a shared constant instance (explosionStrategy); differences between the units are star count, stats and maxPP.

dispatch.registry: AbilityStrategies[Ability.EXPLOSION] = explosionStrategy (the constant `export const explosionStrategy = new ExplosionStrategy()` in explosion.ts)

record.summary: Area self-centred special damage: every unit of the other team standing in the 8 cells around the caster takes SPECIAL damage (raw 50/100/200/400 by caster stars), and the caster then damages itself with the same raw amount unless it holds Protective Pads. If the caster has Magic Bounce active, that self hit is not applied immediately: handleSpecialDamage returns takenDamage 0 and queues a delayed callback (see the self-damage effect). An enemy with Magic Bounce likewise queues a bounce aimed at the caster.

targeting.who: enemy units in the cells adjacent to the caster (not adjacent to the cast target)
targeting.note: requiresTarget is the base default true, so the caster still needs a target in range to cast; the target parameter is only used by super.process for the animation and is not used for the damage. How the target is picked before the cast was not read.

geometry.shape: the 8 board cells around the caster (3x3 minus centre), clipped to the board; allies and empty cells are skipped

effects.target: each enemy in the adjacent cells
effects.scaling: AP: damage x (1 + AP/100) (apBoost defaults to true); the crit flag multiplies by critPower (reduced by the target's crit reduction) only if the cast rolled a crit (needs ABILITY_CRIT because canCritByDefault is false)
effects.resolution: requested = the raw amount; after handleSpecialDamage AP/crit scaling the target's SPE_DEF division (damage / (1 + 0.05 x SPE_DEF), ceil, min 1) and later untraced modifiers; a target with protect / skydiving / magicBounce takes none (takenDamage 0). Damage lands on a shield first (whole amount unless flinched); a Protective Pads holder doubles the amount that hits a shield. The strategy does not read takenDamage, so applied damage does not feed back into the ability. A target with magicBounce also queues a 500-delayed SPECIAL bounce request aimed at the caster unless the caster holds Protective Pads (the bounce amount was not traced further).

effects.target: the caster itself, skipped if it holds PROTECTIVE_PADS
effects.scaling: same raw amount; handleSpecialDamage is called with the caster as attacker, so the caster's own AP (and crit) scale it, then the caster's own SPE_DEF applies
effects.resolution: requested = the raw amount; applied = after the caster's AP/crit, its own SPE_DEF division (ceil, min 1) and its shield; blocked if the caster has protect / skydiving / magicBounce. The caster is not guaranteed to survive; its death handling was not traced. Self Magic Bounce: with magicBounce active on the caster, handleSpecialDamage (damage > 0, attacker = itself, attacker without Protective Pads, which is the only case in which the strategy makes the self hit) returns takenDamage 0 at once and pushes a DelayedCommand with delay 500 onto the caster's own commands. When that callback runs it requests, through handleDamage on the same entity (attacker = itself, SPECIAL, isRetaliation true), round(([0.5, 1, 2, 4][stars - 1] ?? 4) x raw x (1 + AP/100) x critPower if crit). Pinned-helper probe: 1 star, AP 0, noncritical, raw 50 -> immediate takenDamage 0 and one delay-500 callback requesting 25 SPECIAL on itself. This is a queued handler request, not a confirmed final HP loss or live execution timing (whether the callback runs, and the entity's state when it does, were not traced).

starBehavior.note: indexed by the casting entity's stars; the 4-star value (400, also the fallback) is not reachable by the four units' bare star counts. maxPP and range are in appliesTo.

record.positionalConditions: Damages only enemies currently occupying one of the cells touching the caster; if none, only the caster's self-damage (unless Protective Pads) occurs. Cell contents are read at cast time.
record.repeatedCastsAndModes: No stored state, no modes. Each cast repeats the area damage and the self-damage (super.process subtracts maxPP from the caster's pp with a floor of zero, `pokemon.pp = min(0)(pokemon.pp - pokemon.maxPP)`; PP above maxPP, which addPP can leave up to 2 x maxPP - 1, stays as overflow).
record.rawVsResolved: Declared raw: 50/100/200/400 by caster stars (the same number for enemies and for the caster). Dealt = raw x (1 + AP/100) [x crit factor], then the receiver's SPE_DEF division (ceil, at least 1) and untraced modifiers; shield damage counts as damage taken. Requested, applied and takenDamage are not reported by this strategy. Under self Magic Bounce the self hit is a queued request (1 star, AP 0, noncritical raw 50: 25 SPECIAL on itself after a 500 delay), not an immediate takenDamage.
dependsOnUnverifiedGenericCombat: Final damage after handleDamage's later modifiers (items such as Poke Doll, synergy effects, damage-reduction effects, resurrection, field multipliers); only the SPECIAL SPE_DEF division, the minimum of 1 and the shield step were read
When the cast fires in a real fight (PP gain, target selection before the cast, silence); only the pp >= maxPP && canCast gate was read
Death handling of a caster that kills itself with its own explosion (and whether deaths inside the loop change later cells)
unresolved: Routing uncertainty CONSTANT_STRATEGY: the ability is registered through the shared constant explosionStrategy; this record reads the constant's class in explosion.ts and found no other definition, but other registrations of the same constant were not searched
Whether any item or synergy effect other than Protective Pads changes EXPLOSION
Units not listed in appliesTo that might share the identifier are not covered

Whether the delayed self-bounce callback can run, and what the caster's state is when it does (including whether it has already died from other hits), was not traced; the probe exercises the pinned handleSpecialDamage text only
